spec.name: Inferno Rifle — Orange SMP
spec.description: A long, compact netherite rifle with a strong shoulder stock, open trigger guard, ribbed barrel, recessed orange energy channels and amber scope. Angular receiver horns and furnace-jaw muzzle armor suggest a dragon without obscuring the weapon silhouette. Forward is -Z, up is +Y. Fifty editable cuboids use legal Java rotations and a single mapped atlas.

prompt: Generate a NEW complete 3D Inferno Rifle for Orange SMP: a formidable dragon-summoning orbital weapon with a clean, unmistakable rifle silhouette. Chunky dark netherite/charcoal steel receiver, stepped slate-gray armor plates, a strong shoulder stock, angled grip and open trigger guard, ribbed forward barrel, a square furnace muzzle, twin recessed molten-orange energy channels and a raised compact scope with an amber lens. Give it restrained dragon cues: a horn-like upper receiver profile and dragon-jaw shapes at the muzzle, integrated into the rifle rather than a separate animal sculpture. Main palette charcoal, dark warm gray, slate metal, ember red, saturated orange, small pale gold highlights. Refine the craftsmanship and clear material separation; prioritize coherent large shapes and readable negative spaces. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale with mapped per-face painting, broad clean metal value clusters plus irregular close-value wear, darker seams and recesses. Study the local vanilla netherite block, crossbow and spyglass references; do not paste sprite outlines onto the 3D faces. No text, logos or flat decals pretending to be geometry. Generate actual new geometry and fully painted textures through the normal generation pipeline, not an example or imported hand-authored model. Native Java item model export for Paper 26.3. The forward muzzle points along -Z; the top and scope point +Y; centered around X=8. Keep every cuboid within Java bounds [-16,32], use legal Java element rotations, no coplanar overlapping exposed faces; compact enough for hand-held and scoped spyglass use. Aim for roughly 45–80 purposeful cuboids, proportionally long rifle with shoulder stock behind and muzzle forward. Exportable artwork with a distinct silhouette at inventory size.
